file_validity.definition: Solution.u/v read back as float64 with the required (n,1) layout, all values finite, u in [0,1], v >= 0, no float32-quantized nonuniform field, and any attached stability certificate bound to the SHA256 of the same MAT bytes.
file_validity.threshold: structure+precision+range+residual certificate accepted; certificate mat_sha256 == file sha256
file_validity.scope: only runs whose field was saved (formal candidates); robustness/evaluation scans saved no field

steady_full.definition: Complete stationary PDE residual sqrt((RMS_M(Ru)^2+RMS_M(Rv)^2)/2)/F computed from the saved/recorded field with the actual robust L and M, with NO rotation projection.
steady_full.scope: every run that recorded a full residual

relative_equilibrium.definition: Residual after removing the best rigid-rotation fit is below tolerance while the full residual is not: the state is steady only up to a rigid rotation.
relative_equilibrium.scope: spherical runs that recorded rel_residual_rot; not applicable to the frog mesh

spectral.definition: Numerical linear stability of the recorded state from a finite eigenvalue sample. Rotation/tilt-labelled eigenvalues are NEVER excluded from a pass decision.
spectral.threshold: pass iff every sampled |Re lambda| > 1e-09 and no sampled Re lambda > 0; any Re lambda > 0 -> unstable_positive_mode; |Re lambda| <= floor -> insufficient
spectral.scope: only runs where eigenvalues were sampled; otherwise not_checked
spectral.source: turing_rd/stability.py (I02 certificates) or legacy single-shift records

shape.definition: Observed morphology equals the task/reference morphology for that parameter point.
shape.threshold: type == 'spots' for spot tasks; type == 'stripes_or_maze' for stripe tasks; band count is reported separately
shape.scope: every run with a recorded pattern type

budget.definition: The run finished inside its declared physical-time cap instead of stopping at the cap.
budget.threshold: relax_time < t_max (evaluation/robustness t_max = 2e5; training labels t_max = 1e5)
budget.scope: every run with a recorded relax_time

end_to_end.definition: Task success: steady_full AND spectral pass AND shape match AND within budget, with an invalid saved field vetoing the result. A relative equilibrium alone is not a success.
